function clean(v) { return String(v ?? '').trim(); }
function normalizeId(v) {
  return String(v ?? '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
}
function hashString(str) {
  let hash = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i += 1) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = hash >>> 0;
  }
  return hash.toString(16);
}
